itens.de: The city drew newcomers: in 1993, almost four in ten of Lima's residents had been born somewhere else. Many of them built their own homes at the city's edge.
itens.para: The city drew newcomers, and many of them built their own homes at the city's edge.

editor.de:
- "The city drew newcomers: in 1993, almost four in ten of Lima's residents had been born somewhere else."
  - `gen.num-17` (38,8 % "de origen migrante", censo de 1993, pela CVR), `gen-07`. Do `crescer` de p4; o dono vai à tela (para não
    repetir "by census figures the truth commission cites" duas vezes na parte): 1993 · 38.8% OF LIMA'S RESIDENTS BORN ELSEWHERE ·
    1993 CENSUS, CITED BY THE CVR.
- "Many of them built their own homes at the city's edge."
editor.para:
- "The city drew newcomers, and many of them built their own homes at the city's edge." (r2c, G01: saiu o "in 1993, almost four in ten
  of Lima's residents had been born somewhere else", `gen.num-17`, que voltava a linha do tempo de 1993 para 1971 e amarrava as casas
  da borda aos residentes de 1993; o número pode ir à tela da cena, com o dono: 1993 CENSUS, CITED BY THE CVR)

editor.para: (o "almost four in ten … born somewhere else" de 1993 saiu da voz na r2c, G01);
